eraRules.ancient: Bronze/wood melee, shields, chariots and oared ships. No firearms, explosions, engines or electronics.
eraRules.medieval: Steel/wood melee, bows, horses and galleys. No firearms, explosions, engines or electronics.
eraRules.napoleonic: Flintlock muskets, black-powder cannons, horses and sailing ships. No automatic firearms or modern engines.
eraRules.modern: Modern infantry weapons, armored vehicles and naval vessels.

assets.prompt: An ancient battle heard from a hillside 200 meters away. Continuous subdued battle activity with individual impacts blurred by distance. Outdoor field recording. Effects only: no music, speech, synthetic tones or close-up impacts. No firearms, gunpowder, explosions, engines or electronics.
